name: Ancient Ironquill
desc: A Fluffahog of ancient blood, preserved beneath the ice. Even among its primeval kin, it was notorious for its vicious temperament. Modern zoologists often dismiss old illustrations of Fluffahogs carrying Sunsettias on their backs as fanciful exaggerations. Yet if they were ever to lay eyes on one of these enormous Ironquills, its body swollen and its spines hardened to an imposing degree, they might be forced to reconsider.
